title.narrative: Activity under preparation CRESCE - Creation and Development of Sustainable and Circular Economy businesses

description.narrative: The proposed action intends to contribute to the Specific Objective 1.1. of the MIP 2021-2027: ¿Promote green and sustainable economic diversification in Timor-Leste through private sector development, technical and vocational education for youth integration in the labour market.¿ It contributes to Global Gateway Strategy¿s priority area on climate and energy by supporting the transition of countries to a low-carbon, resource-efficient and circular economy.To contribute to the economic diversification of Timor-Leste, the action aims to generate sustainable new jobs in Timor-Leste¿s green and blue sectors, by supporting Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) through technical assistance for the development of a more circular and sustainable economy accessible to all.The action will consider the context and reality of Timor-Leste on business environment, as well as the main difficulties, constrains and needs faced by private sector and entrepreneurs on the creation of their own enterprises and self-employment.It further supports the Timor Leste Government¿s decision to diversify away from its dependency on export of oil and public funds for its revenue creation. The government actively seeks to promote the diversification of the economy and support the integration of women, youth and returning migrants, that face extra challenges in terms of employment and capacity development, into the labour market. The Specific Objective of this action is to:Contribute to the creation and development of green and blue MSMEs and jobs by supporting entrepreneurs, namely women, youth and return migrants, improving their entrepreneurial and management competences and facilitating access to credit. The Outputs to be delivered by this action contributing to the corresponding specific objective are: 1.        Methodology to support entrepreneurs on the creation of their enterprise or self-employment is elaborated and implemented.2.        Modalities of access to credit and finance to business creation available in Timor-Leste are identified and agreements with financial institutions are concluded. 3.        Coaching and training are provided to business creators and entrepreneurs, in their first months of activity.This action is linked with the regional Team Europe Initiative on Green-Blue alliance for the Pacific focusing on climate action, resilience, and sustainable use of natural capital.
